description: This file defines an abstract class 'CellsFactory' responsible for creating 'Cells' instances associated with a worksheet in a PHPSpreadsheet project. It contains a static method to instantiate 'Cells' with caching settings.

classes.name: CellsFactory
classes.description: Abstract factory class for creating Cells objects associated with a worksheet, initializing cache settings.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Cells object linked to the provided Worksheet, applying cache settings.
